title: VPN & Proxy Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy Protection
metaDescription: Calculate your VPN and proxy privacy risk level. Assess security features, logging policies, and jurisdictions to find the safest option.
description: Evaluate the privacy and security risks of your VPN or proxy service. This calculator analyzes key factors like jurisdiction, logging policies, encryption, and payment methods to give you a comprehensive risk assessment.

inputs.label: Service Type
inputs.helpText: Type of service you're using or considering

inputs.label: Company Jurisdiction

options.label: Five Eyes (US, UK, CA, AU, NZ)
Nine Eyes (+ FR, NL, DK, NO)
Fourteen Eyes (+ DE, BE, IT, ES, SE)

inputs.helpText: Where the VPN/proxy company is legally based

inputs.label: Logging Policy
inputs.helpText: What information the service logs about your activity

inputs.label: Encryption Standard
inputs.helpText: Level of encryption used to protect your data

inputs.label: Payment Method Used
inputs.helpText: How you pay affects your anonymity level

inputs.label: Kill Switch Available
inputs.helpText: Blocks internet if VPN connection drops

inputs.label: DNS Leak Protection
inputs.helpText: Prevents DNS queries from bypassing the VPN

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall privacy risk level (0-100, lower is better)

outputFields.label: Risk Grade
outputFields.description: Letter grade assessment of your privacy protection

outputFields.label: Recommendation
outputFields.description: Suggested action based on your risk level

formula: const serviceRisk = { 'vpn': 0, 'proxy': 30, 'socks': 25, 'free-vpn': 50 }[serviceType] || 40; const jurisdictionRisk = { 'five-eyes': 40, 'nine-eyes': 35, 'fourteen-eyes': 30, 'neutral': 0, 'unknown': 25 }[jurisdiction] || 30; const loggingRisk = { 'no-logs': 0, 'claimed-no-logs': 10, 'some-logs': 30, 'full-logs': 50, 'unknown': 35 }[loggingPolicy] || 40; const encryptionRisk = { 'none': 50, 'basic': 30, 'aes-128': 10, 'aes-256': 0, 'unknown': 25 }[encryption] || 30; const paymentRisk = { 'crypto': 0, 'cash': 0, 'paypal': 15, 'credit-card': 25, 'free': 40 }[paymentMethod] || 30; const killSwitchBonus = killSwitch ? -5 : 10; const dnsBonus = dnsLeakProtection ? -5 : 10; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, serviceRisk + jurisdictionRisk + loggingRisk + encryptionRisk + paymentRisk + killSwitchBonus + dnsBonus)); const riskGrade = riskScore <= 20 ? 'A' : riskScore <= 35 ? 'B' : riskScore <= 50 ? 'C' : riskScore <= 70 ? 'D' : 'F'; const recommendation = riskScore <= 20 ? 'Excellent privacy protection' : riskScore <= 35 ? 'Good privacy, minor improvements possible' : riskScore <= 50 ? 'Moderate risk, consider upgrades' : riskScore <= 70 ? 'High risk, switch providers recommended' : 'Very high risk, change immediately'; return { riskScore, riskGrade, recommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates privacy risks based on key factors: service type (VPNs offer better protection than proxies), jurisdiction (countries with strong surveillance laws pose higher risks), logging policies (verified no-logs policies are safest), encryption strength (AES-256 is gold standard), payment anonymity (crypto/cash are most private), and security features like kill switches and DNS leak protection.
tips: Choose VPN providers based in privacy-friendly jurisdictions like Switzerland, Iceland, or Panama
Look for independently audited no-logs policies, not just marketing claims
Use cryptocurrency or cash payments to maintain anonymity when signing up
Always enable kill switch and DNS leak protection features
Consider using Incognito Browser alongside your VPN for maximum privacy protection
